name: Small Magellanic Cloud halo field (Hubble)
blurb: A remote halo field of the Small Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: smchalofield-hubble
story: A quiet stretch of the Small Magellanic Cloud's outer halo, where Hubble counted faint, metal-poor stars to test whether the mix of stellar masses at birth depends on a galaxy's chemistry.

claims.text: QJ0033-2 is a pointing in a remote halo field of the Small Magellanic Cloud (program 13673), at RA 00 33 55.0, Dec -70 30 07
The goal is to measure how the initial mass function depends on metallicity
